## A Studio Unlike Any Other

Warm textures, natural light, and intentional design elements come together to create a space where you can move, recover, and connect. Every detail was chosen to enhance your experience — from premium reformers and heated yoga flooring to thoughtfully curated relaxation spaces.

[VIEW SCHEDULE](https://www.pranawellness.love/book)

<!-- section: px-6.sm:px-10 -->

## Amenities & Spaces

### Co-Ed Sauna

Warm cedar, soft ambient lighting, and grounding heat for muscle recovery & relaxation.

### Locker Rooms

Premium showers, spa-grade products, towel service, and secure lockers.

### Heated Yoga Studio

A warm, light-filled sanctuary designed to support flow, restorative, & meditation.

### Wooden Reformers

Custom-crafted reformers built for smooth resistance & elegant movement.

### Lounge & Elixir Bar

Matcha, adaptogens, smoothies, & cozy space to unwind or connect.

### Cold Plunge

Built for contrast therapy — clarity, invigoration, & recovery.

[BOOK A CLASS](https://www.pranawellness.love/book)
